user_profile: L2-normalize the sum over training ratings of (rating - training_global_mean) * movie_multi_hot_genres
scoring: cosine(user_profile, movie_multi_hot_genres); zero for unknown users, unknown movies, zero profiles, or movies without genres
candidate_exclusion: movies rated by that user in training
zero_profile_fallback: all similarities are zero; deterministic movie_id ascending tie-break
unknown_id_handling: unknown user or movie receives similarity zero; recommendations for an unknown user use deterministic catalogue ordering
